text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: To think I couldn't even make the board...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The racing world is harsh."
Even as someone who studied history, I understood that, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: Failures and setbacks will fuel your future growth.
I need to get my head back in the game too...!
I need to refocus and brace myself too...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: Failures and setbacks will fuel your future growth.
I need to get my head back in the game too...!
I need to refocus and brace myself too...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: History has proven that as well, hasn't it?
History has proven that as well, right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: To overcome adversity and bloom brilliantly once more—that is the drama I will bring to life...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In Chrono Genesis's quietly burning eyes,
I saw undeniable resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono Genesis slaps her own cheeks with both hands.
A crisp, dry smack echoed out."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
I can't just sit around moping either.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"If I am to keep competing against such outstanding rivals from now on...
I cannot stop; I must keep moving forward—"
choice_data_list: Next time, the two of us will leave our mark on history!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I will see it through without fail...!
